verdicts.reason: Fragments confirm first-match CPUID lookup, vaddr/XFD checks, equality check, swap-based staging in kvm_set_cpuid, and host-fill with 0x80000000 leaf clamping.
avic_get_logical_id_entry enforces cluster < 0xf and power-of-2 LDR mask, avic_invalidate_logical_id_entry clears the valid bit, and APICv requires zero inhibit reasons.
__kvm_rmap_lock takes a bitlock with preemption off (empty rmaps require mmu_lock write), and kvm_lockdep_assert_vcpu_is_locked_or_unreachable also permits unreachable vCPUs.
tdp_mmu_next_root asserts mmu_lock and takes RCU read lock; kvm_msr_allowed bypasses x2APIC (0x800-0x8ff), locks kvm->srcu, and defaults to allow/default_allow.

overall: 3 findings are fully supported by the cited KVM x86/MMU/SVM fragments; Finding 3 is partial as it slightly conflates the RMAP bitlock/mmu_lock conditions and omits the unreachable-vCPU exception.
